title: Valid Post-Contextual Bandit Inference
abstract: arXiv:2505.13897v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Contextual multi-armed bandits (CMAB) are increasingly used as adaptively sampled experiments, after which researchers test hypotheses about treatment effects. We derive the H\'ajek-Le Cam limit experiment for multi-armed contextual bandits under equal-arms (weak-signal) asymptotics. It is Locally Asymptotically Quadratic, but not a (mixed) Gaussian shift experiment. Girsanov's theorem gives it a structural representation in stochastic differential equations. Together with a general weak convergence result, this yields the asymptotic null distribution and local asymptotic power of often-used test statistics. Two kinds of nuisance parameters threaten size control: the common reward level of the arms of interest and the rewards of the arms not of interest. translated_title: 情境多臂老虎机后的有效推断
translated_abstract: 情境多臂老虎机（CMAB）越来越多地被用作自适应抽样实验，研究人员随后在其基础上检验关于处理效应的假设。我们在等臂（弱信号）渐近条件下推导了多臂情境老虎机的Hájek-Le Cam极限实验。该极限实验是局部渐近二次的，但并非（混合）高斯移位实验。借助Girsanov定理，我们给出了它在随机微分方程框架下的结构表示。结合一个一般的弱收敛结果，这给出了常用检验统计量的渐近零分布和局部渐近功效。两类冗余参数会对检验水平控制构成威胁：感兴趣各臂的共同奖励水平，以及非感兴趣各臂的奖励。前一种威胁可通过平移不变抽样予以消除。我们提出了Thompson采样、温和技术贪心算法、温和技术（Lin）UCB以及探索型算法的正则化平移不变（RTI）版本……
tldr: 该论文推导了情境多臂老虎机在等臂弱信号渐近下的Hájek-Le Cam极限实验，证明其具有非高斯移位的局部渐近二次结构，并提出正则化平移不变（RTI）算法以消除冗余参数对检验水平控制的威胁，从而实现老虎机实验后的有效统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the Hájek-Le Cam limit experiment for contextual multi-armed bandits under equal-arms (weak-signal) asymptotics, showing it is locally asymptotically quadratic rather than a Gaussian shift experiment, and proposes Regularized Translation-Invariant (RTI) algorithms to eliminate nuisance parameter threats and enable valid post-bandit inference.
